verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says Harbor Compliance prepares or submits foreign-qualification filings when a company expands into another state. The closest items cover different capabilities: automatic annual-report filing, pre-filled state forms that the customer files, obtaining new licenses, and registration tracking. A compliance-services provider could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
